observations.finding: EPA identifies the latest eGRID update as data year 2023.
EPA lists eGRID2023 revision 2 released 2025-06-12 and still presents eGRID2024 only as a planned January 2026 release.
EPA calls eGRID2023 the latest version and recommends matching historical inventory years to the corresponding data year when available.
EPA states that eGRID2023 CO2e uses 100-year AR5 values without climate-carbon feedbacks: CO2 1, CH4 28 and N2O 265.
